status: isolated correctness prototype; not integrated production terrain

complete per-root partition area, unique directed edges and Euler characteristic two
CPU allocator partition and complete diamond merging back to twelve roots
GPU/CPU logical addresses and all edge-neighbor addresses after every replayed request
GPU allocation bits and packed ranks match the existing OCBT mirror; rank-decoded active-index list matches
whole-chain capacity/depth rejection leaves every GPU pool record unchanged
overflow recovery by merging and reallocating without resetting the pool
generation headroom rejection preserves pool/allocator bytes, then fixture recovery
invalid high-bit manual request rejection without mutation
pair-u32 address carry and decoding at total heap depth 58
actual GPU sphere decoder agrees with normalized f64 CPU integer vertices
shared decoded vertices are bit-identical across faces and different subdivision paths
indirect wire capture contains a nonempty sphere

performance.status: verified final isolated hardware run; not a production comparison
performance.excluded_resource_bytes: driver/pipeline/staging memory and CPU oracle state

earlier_serial_classification_exploratio.scope: earlier same-sphere exploratory run; not counterbalanced same-tree A/B evidence or a general speedup claim

performance.comparison: absolute GPU scoped costs only; no equal-error production/large_cbt comparison, no game FPS claim
